To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a two-round DMKD protocol that achieves strong exposure resilience, time-based backward security and scalability under the star topology, and we proved that it is secure in our formal security model.
we have introduced the first formal security model for DMKD protocols and proposed the first DMKD protocol under the star-topology that satisfies our security model in an efficient manner.
we propose the first dynamic multi-cast group key distribution protocol that is scalable and secure in the standard model, and provide the formal security definition and security proof.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following contributions: (1) we introduce the first formal definition of DMKD under star topology, (2) we propose a DMKD protocol that is secure according to our definition, and (3) we prove its security in the standard model.
the construction of a DMKD protocol that is scalable, dynamic, secure and efficient in the standard model.
the following three important issues: (1) scalable DMKD under the centralized topology, (2) formal security model, and (3) provable security.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our protocol is the first scalable DMKD protocol that is provably secure in the standard model under the star topology.
our protocol is the first scalable DMKD protocol with strong exposure resilience and backward secrecy in the star topology.
our protocol is the first DMKD protocol which is secure, dynamic, scalable, and provably secure in the standard model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed the first scalable DMKD protocol under the star network topology which is secure even if private key and session-specific randomness of any user are compromised and which provides time-based backward secrecy.
we have designed a scalable, dynamic and secure key distribution protocol under the star network topology with a central server.
we provide a secure, scalable, dynamic and efficient multi-cast key management protocol under the star network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the security and efficiency of DMKD can be achieved simultaneously.
it is possible to design a DMKD protocol that is scalable, dynamic and strongly resilient against exposure.
the star topology with an authentication server can be used to construct a secure DMKD protocol without sacrificing security and efficiency.
